research_question: When does multidimensional ecological state availability generate repeatable individual state allocation, and when does the resulting time order buffer or destabilize actual experienced environmental conditions?
hypothesis: ACCESSIBLE TARGET-STATE PORTFOLIO, not Shannon thickness alone or pooled individual distributions, constrains potential compensation. Actual temporal organization and individual choice determine whether potential appears as buffered experienced state.

target_concepts.name: state thickness
target_concepts.definition: H(Z|X,Y) for source-consistent realized-use/support; an availability/capacity entropy is a different variable and must be measured separately.

target_concepts.name: repeatable individuality
target_concepts.definition: Identity-conditioned out-of-session distribution-shape information after coarse horizontal and altitude-offset conditioning; not direct resource access or fitness.

target_concepts.name: temporal persistence beyond static preference
target_concepts.definition: P(U_t=U_t-1) minus a time-matched, individual-marginal fitted independent-draw reference; separate from unconditional entropy and variance.

target_concepts.name: experienced environmental buffering
target_concepts.definition: Reduced experienced water-depth dispersion and coupling versus time-matched local available microhabitat, bird as sampling unit.

target_concepts.name: reachable target-state availability
target_concepts.definition: For individual i and time t, fraction of independent, physically reachable availability distribution in an independently defined acceptable state set: K_i(t)=sum_{a in Accept_i} A_i,t(a).
target_concepts.source: theoretical candidate; not measured in all three source repositories

target_concepts.name: complete counterfactual movement benefit
target_concepts.definition: Environmental mismatch at an otherwise unchanged old location versus mismatch at the observed destination in the same future time slice; requires old-site next-time environmental measurements.
target_concepts.source: not yet identified in any three-source matched empirical program

model_contract.static_preference_reference: Draw each next use independent of its previous use under the observed ID-specific marginal state probabilities; this same-data descriptive reference is NOT an independent validation.
model_contract.variance_reference: Variance of a Bernoulli(0.5) available-state draw, 0.25; this synthetic variance ratio is NOT the Louisiana event-matched SRI.

portfolio_contrast.illustrative_choice: P(choose acceptable target)=w*K/(w*K + 1-K) when other choices have weight 1; not a fitted behavioral model.

predeclared_known_truth_tests: Same static structural state entropy, pooled use entropy, individual-state mutual information, per-ID variance, and synthetic SRI must hold exactly across two differently ordered time sequences.
Temporal same-state probability and static-preference-excess contrast must differ and have opposite signs despite matching all these static descriptors.
Equal environmental Shannon entropies can have K(target) of 0.5 versus 0, so total thickness alone cannot guarantee potential target-state matching.
High state persistence can occur with no identity specialization; individual identity is not necessary for state retention.
Finite preference weight never restores a target state if K=0, while K>0 permits but does not guarantee matching.
ecological_preconditions_for_future_join: Same individuals tracked in repeated distinct independent seasons/sessions with identity and time precision.
Source-native GPS x,y,water depth or AGL z and time; tag-altitude reference and habitat availability measured, not inferred from the used distribution.
Repeated local environmental state surface including unvisited old sites at t and t+1, independent of animal occupancy.
Feasible movement destinations and costs/accessibility measured before outcomes.
Acceptable target-state interval fitted from separate training period to avoid tautology.
Sealed future exposure/movement blocks and individual-level bootstrap; spatial/temporal block units separate from GPS fixes.
firewalls: No direct likelihood-based aggregation of ODSP entropy, batter permutation-calibrated prediction and Louisiana water-depth regression.
No claim that bat elevation identity improves survival or King Rail source data prove coordinate-level adaptive tracking.
ODSP model-pool support is not physical structural environmental capacity and must not be substituted for K.
No retroactive ecological refit of frozen ODSP, batter or Louisiana original outcome analyses.
All conclusions from known-truth examples are analytic possibilities, not new animals, landscapes, or independent empirical replication.
